data.summary: A TypeScript Express backend with Neon Postgres, JWT authentication (access + revocable refresh tokens), S3-compatible file storage, and a role-gated product catalog — this is the reference application (Archive.zip) re-expressed as a composed graph, demonstrating that the template library can reproduce it faithfully while fixing the gaps REFERENCE_ARCHITECTURE.md documents (swallowed upload errors, unimplemented refresh token, no file validation, no RBAC enforcement), plus a full CRUD resource the reference app never had, to exercise api.crud end to end.
